response.rationale: Both translations match the English cue and sense. Indonesian usage supports sarung tangan oven, while Malaysian reference usage supports sarung tangan ketuhar. The forms represent a useful national-preference contrast, not a semantic contrast; Malaysian casual use of oven does not invalidate the card. No false-friend issue is present.
